About & logs has a new "Save a diagnostics file" button: attach that one file to a bug report. It records your computer, display, HDR and game folder setup, and hides your user name, computer name and home folder.
The pause menu now blurs and tints the game behind it in the New renderer, as in the original.
Pre-1.0 renderer: the blurred background of the pause menu looks the same at higher render resolutions as at 720p instead of showing a dotted grid.
Pre-1.0 renderer: a larger depth margin for graffiti, bullet holes, blood and burn marks, aimed at the one-frame flicker some players see on an RTX 4060.
A building in the car park chapter that was too dark in the New renderer is now lit by the sun like the rest of the level.
On a first visit to a level, trees that come into view now appear within a second or two instead of up to a minute later.
Textures for things on screen now load ahead of the background preload, so after a fresh start you see grey or blocky stand-ins for less time.
